letter.company_line: Ferrycarrig is a utilities and civil infrastructure contractor that has worked on Sydney Light Rail, Parramatta Light Rail, Sydney Metro and Western Sydney Airport.
letter.subject: Graduate Civil Engineer, Sydney
paragraphs: Please accept my application for the Graduate Civil Engineer role on your Sydney civil infrastructure project. Working with site supervisors on coordination, inspections, ITPs and daily reports is the site career I want to build, and it builds on work I have already done.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed structural and architectural drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports and progress reports, and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to keep work moving.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019), and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards.

I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, and am open to discussing relocation to Sydney for this role. My site experience is about ten months and overseas, so I would be learning Australian ITPs and quality records from your team.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.

checklist: Search Gmail in:anywhere for Ferrycarrig before applying (Gmail was not reachable on this tick)

Find the live advert (seen on SimplyHired/Indeed mirrors, posted about 3 Nov 2026; not on SEEK; Ferrycarrig's own board showed no listings) and apply there, or use Register your interest on jobboards.adlogic.com.au/ferrycarrig
Decide whether a move to Sydney suits you; the letter says you are open to discussing relocation
Attach the resume and cover letter from this folder; be ready to answer salary and start date yourself
